Class GuiItemManager

java.lang.Object
me.leoko.advancedgui.manager.GuiItemManager
public class GuiItemManager extends Object
The GuiItemManager manages available GuiItemInstances and keeps track of which player is currently interacting with which instance.

  • Method Details

    • setup

      public void setup()
      Creates GuiItemInstances for all known 1x1 layouts and starts a repeating scheduler to track players interactions.

      This method should not be called manually. AdvancedGUI makes sure that the Manager is always setup.

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Disposes all resources and tasks this manages holds.
